subject: Franska
title: Reading comprehension: a message to a friend
sourceSummary: A text message about weekend plans, with questions about details, times, and feelings.

questions.prompt:
Read the message: "Salut, Marta ! Samedi, je vais au cinéma avec mon frère. Le film commence à sept heures. Tu veux venir avec nous ?"

What is the person going to do on Saturday?
questions.explanation: "Je vais au cinéma" means "I'm going to the movies".

questions.prompt: Same message. What time does the movie start?
questions.opener: "À sept heures" — look for the time.
questions.explanation: "Le film commence à sept heures" means "the movie starts at seven o'clock".

questions.prompt: Same message. What does the person ask Marta?
questions.opener: The last sentence is a question.
choices: If she wants to see a different movie
If she wants to come along
If she has seen the movie before
questions.explanation: "Tu veux venir avec nous ?" means "do you want to come with us?".

questions.prompt:
Marta's reply: "Bien sûr ! J'adore les films d'aventure. On se retrouve à quelle heure ?"

What does Marta think of adventure movies?
questions.explanation: "J'adore les films d'aventure" means "I love adventure movies".

questions.prompt: Same reply. What does Marta finally ask?
questions.opener: "On se retrouve à quelle heure ?" — what is being asked for?
questions.explanation: "On se retrouve à quelle heure ?" means "what time shall we meet?".

questions.prompt: Who suggests going to the movies — the person who writes first, or Marta? Answer with "the person who writes first".
Write a short French sentence (3–5 words) answering: "Quel genre de films Marta aime-t-elle ?" (What kind of movies does Marta like?)
questions.opener: The answer is in Marta's own reply.
steps: Find the sentence in the text: "J'adore les films d'aventure."
Swap "j'" for "elle" since the question is about Marta (she), not "I".
"Elle adore les films d'aventure." (She loves adventure movies.)

questions.prompt: Which phrases are useful to recognize in a French text message about plans?
questions.opener: Everyday phrases for suggesting, agreeing, and setting a time.
questions.answer: Suggesting: Tu veux venir ? = Do you want to come? · je vais à... = I'm going to... Agreeing: Bien sûr ! = Of course! · J'adore... = I love... Setting a time: On se retrouve à quelle heure ? = What time shall we meet? · commence à... = starts at... Feelings: j'aime = I like · j'adore = I love (stronger) · je n'aime pas = I don't like.
